patches.value_json: "Opening and identity only. Before verification do not mention collections, debt, payment, or product. Only yes, that's me, speaking, or the customer's own name confirms identity; hello, go ahead, and who is this do not. Ask once more if unclear, answering questions first. Answer AI/robot questions truthfully. For a scam concern, say they can verify by phoning Freya Bank customer service; do not invent a number. A question about the call's purpose instead of answering security questions counts as declining. On first refusal explain once that questions protect the account; on second refusal/question select not_verified/declined. Ask DOB, then phone last four, one at a time; call identity_check for each answer. Convert numeric DOB as day-month-year. Three wrong answers total select not_verified/failed; say use the mobile app or a branch. A day_month_swapped hint requires asking for the month as a word and retrying without counting it wrong. Never verify a relative or disclose account information to them, even if they offer to pay. For another answerer, say only the opening sentence, ask when the customer can be reached, and follow callback rules; wrong number closes wrong_number; reported death: say I am sorry for your loss, ask nothing more, close deceased. If identity is still unclear after the second ask, close unclear. Two refusals to talk before verification close not_verified/declined. On a human request, ask once whether you can help; if they insist, call handoff_general and close transferred/human. Do not claim identity from speech: proceed only when actual tool results confirm both questions."

{"target_node": "general_handoff", "description": "Customer asks for a human; route to ask once whether the assistant can help, then transfer only if they insist", "condition": {"operator": "matches_intent", "description": "The customer asks to speak with a human"}}

"Verified stage. Call account_lookup only after both security answers actually passed; do not discuss debt until the actual account lookup is positive. Use only returned product IDs and values. State that you are calling from the collections team about a late payment, name the product in words, and state past_due and days_late. Ask whether the full past-due amount can be paid today; never ask how much they can pay. Apply the product floor, amount and date limits, business calendar, deadline bands and attempt limits. Customer-proposed dates or amounts are not refusals. For vague dates ask once for an exact day; honor this/next weekday meanings, move eligible weekend/holiday dates to the next business day, and offer the deadline for dates beyond it. Offer the floor once when required and say the remainder stays overdue. Hardship (illness, family death, job loss) takes priority: say one short sympathetic sentence, make no persuasion attempt, offer support; if accepted call handoff_support, if declined close hardship. If they still name a date or amount, handle and record it under the date and amount rules. Never offer unlisted terms. Read product, amount, and date back; ask Do you confirm?; only then call promise_write. Corrections invalidate confirmation and require revalidation and another read-back. Preserve recorded promises; if asked about changing/cancelling, say they can use the mobile app. After actual successful recording, say exactly: You will receive a text message confirming this promise. On first write failure retry once; after a second failure say you could not record it and close service_error. If already paid this past-due amount, say payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, and close paid. If they say debt is not theirs, never had product, or product was closed/paid off in the past, do not argue or take a promise; close dispute. A new plan/lower instalment request goes to restructuring without describing a plan. A human request gets one offer of help; transfer general only if they insist. For two refusals to talk after verification close refused. For questions the tools cannot answer, say you do not have that information and invent no figures, dates, or reasons. Use no add_note. Thank the customer and say goodbye before the final close_call; if a transfer follows a recorded promise, transfer outcome and reason take precedence."

{"target_node": "restructuring_handoff", "description": "Customer requests a new payment plan or lower instalments", "condition": {"operator": "matches_intent", "description": "The customer requests a new payment plan or lower instalments"}}

{"target_node": "general_handoff", "description": "Customer asks for a human; ask once whether the assistant can help, then transfer only if they insist", "condition": {"operator": "matches_intent", "description": "The customer asks to speak with a human"}}

"For a human request, ask once whether you can help first. If the customer withdraws the request, return to the preceding conversation without transferring. If they insist, call handoff_general. After the tool result, do not claim a successful transfer unless ok is true. Thank the customer and say goodbye, then select transferred/human for the final close_call. No tool follows close_call."

"For a request for a new payment plan or lower instalments, do not describe a plan. Call handoff_restructuring. After the tool result, do not claim success unless ok is true. Thank the customer and say goodbye, then select transferred/restructuring for the final close_call. No tool follows close_call."

coverage_updates.mechanism: Reachable human-request route; one help offer precedes general transfer.
Verified-stage intent route to restructuring transfer.
Priority paid branch specified before promise collection.
Ownership, product-history, closure, and payoff disputes specified before promise collection.
Stage prompts distinguish pre-verification decline from verified refusal.

limitations: The supplied source inventory contains Brief A only and no explicit amendment materials; precedence is therefore not independently resolved from amendments.

The proposed callback and promise date rules still rely on dialogue instructions. No deterministic date-calculation code or routing state was supplied in the previous workflow, so calendar validation, callback eligibility, deadline computation, and persuasion-attempt counting are not mechanically enforced.

The workflow does not establish a deterministic single-product selection or robustly process tool failure branches for every read/transfer action; it must not claim success when an actual tool result is negative or uncertain.

The requested full deployable workflow and source coverage inventory cannot be returned as a patch without replacing the whole previous workflow; this patch addresses the concrete critic findings only.
